scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --type-check --fix apps packages tools
scripts.format: pnpm nx run-many -t format && pnpm exec oxfmt nx.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: pnpm nx run-many -t format:check && pnpm exec oxfmt --check nx.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm nx run-many -t lint typecheck test
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-path hooks >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; uv run prek install --hook-type pre-commit --overwrite
